title: Natural polymer-based bioadsorbents for wastewater treatment
content:
RSC Sustainability, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SU00369E, Critical Review

Akhtar Alam, Atikur Hassan, Zernain Sultana, Neeladri Das
Rapid urbanization, industrial growth and rising living standards have intensified global water pollution, creating ecological and health hazards. Using biopolymer-based adsorbents for sustainable remediation offers an eco-friendly and efficient way to remove contaminants from wastewater.
